message: type invariant of `invf::Span` may not hold for argument `Span { lo: a, hi: b }` of `invf::take` in `invf::argument`; counterexample: a = 0, b = -1, argument = Span { lo: 0, hi: -1 }
type invariant of `invf::Span` may not hold for the result at the end of the body in `invf::tail`; counterexample: a = 1, result = Span { lo: 1, hi: 0 }
type invariant of `invf::Span` may not hold for the result at this `return` in `invf::early`; counterexample: a = 11, result = Span { lo: 11, hi: 10 }
type invariant of `Result<i64, invf::Span>` may not hold for the result at this `?` in `invf::tried`; counterexample: a = -9223372036854766953, result = Err(Span { lo: 1, hi: 0 })
type invariant of `invf::Span` may not hold for `*s` (a `&mut` parameter) at the end of the body in `invf::shrink`; counterexample: s = Span { lo: -14, hi: 0 }, *s = Span { lo: -14, hi: -100 }
type invariant of `invf::Span` may not hold for `s` on entry to the loop in `invf::entry`; counterexample: n = 0, s on entry = Span { lo: 1, hi: 0 }

type invariant of `invf::Span` may not hold for `s` when the loop goes back to its head in `invf::iteration`; counterexample: s = Span { lo: -9223372036854767443, hi: 0 }, n = 2, s after the iteration = Span { lo: 1, hi: 0 }
divisor may be zero in `invf::opaque`; counterexample: s = Span { lo: 0, hi: -1 }

fix.message: the proof sees `ordered` only by name; if the failure depends on its definition, add to #[uses(ordered)]

message: type invariant of `invf::List` may not hold for the result at the end of the body in `invf::cons`; counterexample: l = List::Nil, x = 100, result = List::Cons(100, List::Nil)
type invariant of `invf::Span` may not hold for argument `s` of `invf::fill` in `invf::instance`; counterexample: a = 1, argument = Span { lo: 1, hi: 0 }
